title: Shape Integrity Scoreboard and Change Attribution for Structured Outputs
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Problem: Structured outputs (JSON/typed blobs) occasionally regress after model or config changes. Existing alerts are binary (violation/no-violation) and flood on any minor field fluctuation. We need a continuous, attributable signal that quantifies 'shape integrity' per field and per route, ties score changes to specific commits/config deltas and can power canary gating and automated rollback suggestions.

Goal: Build a Shape Integrity Scoreboard that produces per-field and aggregate integrity scores (0-100), tracks confidence and sample counts, attributes significant drops to either model changes, config flags (quantization, kernel selection, KV cache settings), or prompt/template updates, and surfaces actionable context in Console + alerting. The scoreboard should be cheap to compute for frequent canary runs and statistically robust enough for automated decisions (canary pass/fail).

Approach summary: 1) Define per-field metrics: presence rate, type-fidelity, enum-coherency, value-distribution-shift (KL/probabilistic), and schema-conformance ratio. 2) Compute per-field sensitivity using a weighted ensemble and produce a composite integrity score for the route. 3) Use paired-sample evaluation across control (baseline model/config) and candidate (new model/config) cohorts, applying permutation tests and bootstrap CI to assess significance. 4) Attribution: correlate top-scoring regressions with config diffs (from rollout metadata) and model version diffs; run lightweight ablations (toggle quantize/kv-cache flags) in sandbox to isolate root cause. 5) Operationalize: schedule scoreboard runs on every canary and on config PRs; store rolls for 90 days; add Console scoreboard UI with per-field time series and a change attribution panel.

Tradeoffs and decisions so far: we prefer paired testing (vs independent) to increase statistical power but it requires deterministic input sampling. To limit cost we will sample stratified subsets per route (by prompt length, user cohort) and maintain a separate high-fidelity nightly full-eval for long-term trends. We will redact PII in samples and limit retention for privacy compliance.
tasks: Define metric schema and scoring rules (presence/type/enum/ks/kld) and document in Confluence
Implement lightweight evaluation job in evaluations-service (canary runner) that outputs per-field histograms and scores
Add change-diff extractor to rollout pipeline to surface config and model deltas into eval metadata
Integrate paired statistical tests (permutation + bootstrap) in the eval lib and expose p-values/CI in JSON output
Create Console Scoreboard mockups and wireframe interaction for attribution drilldown
Hook scoreboard results into Alerting: create alert rules for significant score drops and auto-create rollback suggestion cards
Add end-to-end tests and a performance budget: per-route canary run should complete < 90s for sampled set
Write runbook for triage (how to interpret field scores, suggested ablations, who to page)
comments: 2025-01-22 - Priya Kapoor: Spike complete. Paired sampling increases signal/noise by ~2x compared to independent cohorts on our toy dataset. Found that sampling determinism is the biggest engineering challenge when users have nondeterministic prompt generation.

2025-01-24 - Diego Martinez: Implemented prototype eval job and output schema (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/187). Prototype exports per-field histograms and a composite score. Need API shape review from SDK team.
2025-01-28 - Ava Chen (PM review): Confirmed alerting thresholds should be configurable per-project. Suggested adding a 'severity weight' per field (e.g., user_id mismatch high weight).
2025-01-30 - Security: flagged retention of raw samples — we will add PII redaction step before storage and limit raw sample access to SOC. Security requested a review if retention > 90 days.

2025-02-01 - Diego Martinez: Added attribution hook which correlates top regressions with rollout diff. Early tests show quantization toggle explains ~60% of field-level score drops for the e-commerce demo.
2025-02-02 - Design: uploaded initial scoreboard mockups (Drive: https://drive.google.com/mockups/shape-scoreboard-v1). Design requests a compact heatmap view for multi-route overviews.
acceptance_criteria: Scoreboard computes per-field and aggregate integrity scores for a route and returns JSON within the canary run SLA (<90s for sampled set)
Paired statistical tests return p-value and 95% CI and are reproducible on the same sample inputs
Attribution panel links the top 3 regressions to the smallest set of config/model diffs explaining >50% of the observed drop or marks 'unknown'
Console displays scoreboard with per-field time-series and heatmap for at least 3 routes
Alerting rules trigger on configurable thresholds and create a follow-up ticket with scoreboard snapshot and suggested ablations
